# Denylist of org-identifying strings that must never appear in this
# public repo (github.com/ajanatka/lean-flow).
#
# lean-flow is public. Hano/eamesly-specific content (product code,
# infrastructure identifiers, internal docs, workflow agents tuned to
# that org) belongs in the private eamesly/hano-agents repo, not here.
# If you're adding something that trips this list, move it there
# instead of editing the list to let it through.
#
# One extended-regex (grep -E) pattern per line. This file itself is
# excluded from the scan it powers (see
# .github/workflows/hano-tripwire.yml), so it is safe to name the
# protected strings here even though the workflow forbids them
# everywhere else.

eamesly
\bhano\b
